newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan key 3-mth CD rate rises to 0.62% on 'tankan'.
newsitem.headline: Japan key 3-mth CD rate rises to 0.62% on 'tankan'.

text.p: The benchmark three-month certificates of deposit (CD) rate rose to 0.62 percent on Wednesday, the highest level since August 20, 1996, after the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) "tankan" corporate sentiment survey showed big Japanese manufacturers grew optimistic this month.
Traders said about 100 billion yen worth of three-month CDs were issued at 0.62 percent by early afternoon, up from the previously issued rate of 0.60 percent.
Two- and one-month CD rates also rose to 0.61 percent and 0.60 percent respectively, they said.
